skills.description: A Skill that provides very powerful support instantly, and switches to a powerful AoE attack after use. The more characters from the and Factions you have, the stronger the buffs you'll receive, so keep that in mind when forming your party.

skills.name: Convallaria Swordplay
skills.description: A Decision Skill with Magical AoE DMG and AoE Knockback. Basically, use [Convallaria - Blooming Horizon], but when you can aim for a fall kill or collision, use [Convallaria - Windswept Blossom]. Be aware that [Convallaria - Windswept Blossom] deals Physical DMG, so the "Magical AoE DMG increase" from Gear will have no effect.
